answer: A farm paying its aliases from one wallet therefore collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. Because the ripple graph is rebuilt each epoch, the signal merge is applied at settlement and the pulse audit lists every linked key. Identities funded from a common source within 38 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. That is 5 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
